title: [ingest] ORCH_WORKSPACE exists because the MCP server otherwise hijacks the global workspace
summary: mcp-graph.js used to POST process.cwd() as the daemon workspace on startup, so any headless agent loading the MCP from inside a git worktree repointed the live graph and blinded the real workspace. WS now honors ORCH_WORKSPACE when set (else cwd). This was 'dogfood-finding #1' — set ORCH_WORKSPACE for any worktree-based agent.
